name: Chihara Miyabi
source:
She is a Miko and a gentle and quiet step mother.

She is kind and considerate to Ryousuke and his troubled feelings. Her family is heavily in debt and she must be liked by him to repay the debt. She questions whether she is the right person to be his mother due to her situation.

As a step mother, she tries to heal Ryosuke's heart, and has plenty of skinship with him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=28722]Getchu[/url]]
